integration_policy.rule: If either fresh agent finds a plausible activation, preserve it. If labels differ, keep the stronger or more discovery-oriented reading unless contradicted by the root audit.

surface_mechanism: قُلْ frames the surah as commanded public proclamation and identity-definition.
الله أحد establishes unique identity; the final أحد extends negation exhaustively to any possible counterpart.
الصمد activates dependence, solidity, sealing, supervision, and endurance as mutually reinforcing readings.
لم يلد ولم يولد blocks offspring, parentage, derivation, generation, temporal origination, and dependency in both directions.
ولم يكن له كفوا أحد negates counterpart, comparison, status, place, reproductive equivalence, and any diverting rival orientation.
